lead.t: Hereditary intrinsic factor deficiency (HIFD) is a rare autosomal recessive disorder caused by a variety of mutations in the IF gene that produce a lack of gastric IF or a functionally abnormal IF.

snip.t: Hereditary intrinsic factor deficiency (HIFD) is a rare autosomal recessive disorder caused by a variety of mutations in the IF gene that produce a lack of gastric IF or a functionally abnormal IF.
Hereditary intrinsic factor deficiency and Imerslund-Gräsbeck disease are inborn errors of metabolism leading to vitamin B12 malabsorption
